name: Tanin no Nyoui o Jiyuu ni Ayatsureru Nouryoku o Te ni Ireta no de Mukatsuku Classmate o Omorashi Sasete Yaru!!
original_name: 他人の尿意を自由に操れる能力を手に入れたのでムカつくクラスメイトをおもらしさせてやる!!
source:
One day, Kiyotaka got the power to control other people's urge to piss from a fairy (?) called Wannapee. He was pumped about getting to try it out on some cute girls, but as it turned out, the power only works on guys.

With nothing better to do, he decided to use the power to bully his classmates.

translation:
有一天，清隆从一位名叫万纳皮（Wannapee）的仙女（？）那里得到了控制别人小便冲动的能力。他很高兴能在一些可爱的女孩身上尝试一下，但事实证明，这种力量只对男孩有效。

无奈之下，他决定利用权力欺负同学。
